
# A monitoring tool posts an alert with the space's intake key
$ curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4050/api/alerts -H 'Authorization: Bearer shep_fb_rtwTbB…' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Checkout 5xx above 5%","severity":"Critical","detail":"Error rate on POST /checkout rose from 0.2% to 7% at 09:58.","url":"https://grafana.acme.dev/d/checkout","namespace":"shop","workload":"checkout","context":"prod","externalId":"grafana-812"}'
{"id":"93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e","duplicate":false}

# The same alert again is a note, not a second incident
$ curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4050/api/alerts -H 'Authorization: Bearer shep_fb_rtwTbB…' -d '…same alert…'
{"id":"93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e","duplicate":true}
$ shep incident ls --open

  Incidents (1)

  Id                                      Incident                            Severity    Status      Workload                
  93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e    Checkout 5xx above 5%               Critical    Open        shop/checkout

# Triage: evidence from the workload, ranked causes, one proposed action
$ shep incident triage 93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e
i Reading the workload and asking the agent; this can take a few minutes…
i Checkout 5xx above 5%: errors began right after the latest rollout of shop/checkout.
i   1. The latest release introduced a regression (High)
i   2. Pods are short of memory under load (Medium)
i   3. A downstream dependency is slow (Low)
i Waiting for approval: rollback: Proposed — run shep incident approve 44c1706c-5dbf-40d0-9cc0-92247fed7b83
$ shep incident show 93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e
i Checkout 5xx above 5% Critical · Open

i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.447Z Evidence: Rollout status:
      NAME       READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE   CONTAINERS   IMAGES
      checkout   1/3     3            1           2d    checkout   registry.acme.dev/checkout:4.12.0

      Recent logs:
      ERROR TaxClient: unexpected field "jurisdiction" in response (4.12.0)
      ERROR POST /checkout 502 upstream tax-service
i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.750Z Note: Checkout 5xx above 5%: errors began right after the latest rollout of shop/checkout.
i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.751Z Hypothesis: The latest release introduced a regression (High) — Errors start with the newest replica set; earlier pods were healthy.
i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.751Z Hypothesis: Pods are short of memory under load (Medium) — Restarts cluster around traffic peaks.
i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.751Z Hypothesis: A downstream dependency is slow (Low) — Some timeouts mention an upstream call.
i   2026-10-05T07:20:47.752Z ActionProposed: Agent proposed rollback: Errors began with the latest rollout; roll back to the last healthy revision.
i   44c1706c-5dbf-40d0-9cc0-92247fed7b83 rollback: Proposed

# Acme only lets shep restart on its own, so the rollback waits for a person
$ shep incident approve 44c1706c-5dbf-40d0-9cc0-92247fed7b83
√ rollback: Succeeded, recovered

# Restarts are allowed: a person's action runs at once
$ shep incident act 93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e restart --reason "Clear stuck connections"
√ restart: Succeeded, recovered
$ shep incident note 93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e "Tax service vendor confirmed a schema change in 4.12"
√ Note added

# A second, minor incident opened by hand
$ shep incident open "Search is slow" -s acme --severity minor --workload search --namespace shop
√ Incident 9e53051f-1371-4db0-bfaa-80558660ce3a opened: Search is slow
$ shep incident resolve 93ec3451-6512-42eb-9b0e-5db91587527e
√ Checkout 5xx above 5% resolved
